Your character's Force Powers collectively form a suite. When your character uses a Force Power, it's like playing a card and putting it in the discard pile. The Force Power takes effect, and it's no longer available to the character... at least for a while. When your character uses a Force Power, make a
check. The check result determines the Force Power's effect.
Some Force Powers have all-or-nothing effects. Other Force Powers have multi-tiered effects, and your
check result determines the maximum effect you can achieve, although you can always choose a lesser effect. If your
